A sparse explicitly labelled ABN column can have high mapping confidence; absent values emit nothing. The abn transform already normalizes spaces and enforces checksum, rejecting compound identifiers. For labelled free text, a regex extracting exactly one labelled ABN is allowed; if multiple matches exist, the engine refuses the field. Do not reject a safe single-identifier extraction solely because other rows contain multiple suppliers. Preserve ambiguous names as unmapped. Correct invalid transforms, weak semantic mappings, and fields with poor coverage. Return {config:<complete revised config>, changes:[{field,before,after,reason}], semantic_risks:[...], requires_human_review:true}. Explicitly retain mappings only with defensible evidence.
